rollups.text: The user’s recurring dance and fitness activities include salsa lessons (three weeks of lessons and progress with the cross-body lead, 2023-05-21), rehearsing and preparing to perform in a hip-hop studio showcase to an unnamed Ariana Grande song with a group of about 10 dancers (2023-05-21), attending spinning classes and seeking playlists (2023-05-21), a Saturday boot-camp class (2023-05-21), morning jogging (2023-05-28), Saturday-morning tennis with friends (2023-05-28), and studio yoga three times a week (2023-05-28).

The user’s recorded possessions and family heirlooms include a silver cuff (acquired by 2023-05-21); an antique pearl necklace inherited from the user’s grandmother and appraised locally in February 2023; an Olympus OM-1 film camera inherited from the user’s grandfather, serviced and cleaned by 2023-05-22; an antique vase inherited from the user’s grandmother, dating to the early 1900s; an old wooden clock purchased in 2023 and dating to the 1800s; and a family heirloom wooden table. The user also owns a road bike, a tennis racket, a yoga mat, and Nike Dri-FIT running socks; the user got Asics Gel-Kayano running shoes in April 2023.

The user’s recurring interests in books and screen media include science fiction and fantasy, contemporary fiction, debut novels and emerging authors, and attending book festivals, author readings, and book events (2023-05-25). The user read friend Rachel’s debut novel, The Art of Falling, and praised its writing, characters, and themes (date unspecified). The user finished The Expanse and considered Westworld, Raised by Wolves, Watchmen, and The Leftovers; on 2023-05-30 the user chose Watchmen and planned to watch two or three episodes weekly.

The user’s recorded pet-related purchases include Luna’s annual veterinary check-up and vaccinations for $120 around 2023-05-02, Luna’s $15.99 stainless-steel food bowl from Petco (date unspecified), and Max’s $40 dog bed bought from Amazon in April 2023. The user also bought a pack of Luna’s favorite wet food, but its purchase date and cost are unknown. The user has not yet booked Max’s dental cleaning or bought the planned pack of 500 poop bags, estimated at about $10 from Chewy.com; these are plans, not completed purchases.

The user’s recurring photography interests include using an inherited Olympus OM-1 film camera, planning a scenic-park test outing for the weekend of 2023-05-27 to 2023-05-28, learning to develop film, and collecting photography books, especially works by Ansel Adams and Henri Cartier-Bresson. The user had the camera serviced and cleaned by 2023-05-22 and planned to store it in a protective case when not in use.

The user’s Ravnica Dungeons & Dragons campaign world-building began by establishing a preference for richly detailed, lore-filled responses inspired by D&D books and The Lord of the Rings (2023-05-23). The campaign then introduced Azorius Lawmage Elion Viryx, his background and potential role as an ally, and his investigation into the Silent Seraphim (2023-05-23). The conspiracy involves thefts from guild vaults and a plan to reshape Ravnica; eight guild relics were specified, while the coalition’s intended combined use for them remained unknown. All documented developments occurred on 2023-05-23.

The user’s ongoing fictional adventure follows MK, Mei, Tang, Macaque, and Sun Wukong. On 2023-05-21, the group hid in the jungle after freeing an injured Macaque, who wanted to reclaim his mountain kingdom from Sun Wukong’s golden-haired army. They made camp, and Macaque described the mountain’s former peace, the betrayal that enabled the invasion, and his goal of restoring the kingdom. Later, MK dreamed that Wukong found the camp, berated him, and threatened his friends; MK awoke frightened that Wukong would find them. The user requested detailed campfire, dialogue, and nightmare scenes.

The user developed a plan to track product-launch form submissions in Google Analytics. On 2023-05-27, while analyzing launch traffic and applying skills from Coursera courses in Google Analytics and Excel, the user chose Google Tag Manager to create an event tag and form-submission trigger, connect them, and publish the container. The user then chose GTM Preview/Debug Mode to submit a test form and verify that the tag fires. The records do not report whether the test succeeded.

The user planned publicity for a new HR hub site at the bank where the user works. On 2023-05-27, the user was designing a Canva teaser banner with an animated, loading-menu-style HTML-code concept and wanted a witty tagline. The site launch was scheduled for Friday, 2023-06-02; the records do not establish whether the launch occurred.

The user worked on a joint market promotion with the user’s sister, who sells eco-friendly cleaning products. After returning from the Earth Day Market with the sister on 2023-05-27, the user considered ways to reduce waste at outdoor events and promote reusable bags and bamboo utensils at the Summer Kick-Off Market. The user considered a joint discount and then proposed a limited-time offer: a free reusable bag with purchases of a bamboo utensil set and the sister’s eco-friendly all-purpose cleaner, limited to the first 20 customers purchasing within 48 hours. The records do not state whether the offer was run.

The user began preparing for the CPA exam on 2023-05-24. The user considered Becker CPA Review but was concerned about its price, said they would investigate free and low-cost practice-question resources, and planned to survey all four exam sections to identify weak areas before focusing study and reviewing material across sections. The user asked whether to study one section at a time or all four together, but no final choice between those strategies was recorded.

The user’s bedroom updates included rearranging the room by 2023-05-28, placing the bed against the window wall and the desk against the closet wall. The user replaced an old area rug with a lighter-colored one, which made the room feel brighter, and considered warm, minimalist bedside lamps including the IKEA NOT Lamp and CB2 Simple Glass Table Lamp. The user planned to visit CB2 to view the latter and was also considering a task lamp with a USB port.

The user investigated the history and care of an antique vase inherited from the user’s grandmother. On 2023-05-30, the user sought appraisal and preservation guidance, wanted to learn the vase’s maker and prior ownership, and decided to display it on a protective surface on a family heirloom wooden table to avoid damaging either object. The user also sought appraisal advice for a recently purchased 1800s wooden clock and general care advice for other antiques.

The user’s Top Position prospecting work developed across multiple revisions on 2023-05-29. The user wanted a call script promoting local SEO and Google Ads to busy small-business owners in service industries, including IV services, medical procedures, HVAC, and electrical work. After a draft leaned too heavily on “10x” messaging, the user asked for a wiser, more measured approach. A later script addressed objections about time, already having enough business, prior unsuccessful marketing, unfamiliarity with SEO or Google Ads, and cost, and proposed a 15-minute call the next day.

The records document at least seven distinct fitness or dance activity types for the user: salsa, hip-hop dance, spinning, boot camp, jogging, tennis, and yoga. This is a count of activity types, not a count of sessions; only yoga is explicitly recorded as occurring three times weekly, and tennis as occurring every Saturday morning.

The user’s recorded completed pet expenses total $175.99 across two pets: Luna’s expenses total $135.99 ($120 veterinary check-up and vaccinations around 2023-05-02 plus a $15.99 Petco bowl of unspecified purchase date), and Max’s recorded expense is a $40 Amazon dog bed bought in April 2023. The planned poop-bag purchase is excluded; the wet-food cost is unknown.

The user changed direction on replacement headphones: after losing Sony WF-1000XM4 earbuds gifted by the user’s sister, the user considered buying replacements and was undecided between noise-cancelling and more affordable options, including comparing Apple AirPods Pro with Sony or Sennheiser. Separately, the user had bought wireless headphones on Amazon around 2023-05-06 at 20% off and, by 2023-05-27, decided to keep using those current headphones rather than shop for another pair. The records do not establish that the purchased headphones were replacements for the lost earbuds.
rollups.topic: headphone plans and change of decision

rollups.text: The user’s plans for apartment decorating shifted between wanting striking, unconventional, low-budget ideas such as a living wall or glass floor and asking for temporary, removable versions because landlord approval was uncertain (2023-05-30). The user also expressed interest in personalizing the apartment with unconventional materials or DIY decor, but later emphasized wanting low-effort changes because of feeling lazy. The user liked a statement mirror that would feel cozy and inviting rather than flashy or tacky; no specific decor item was selected.
